claim_text: Somatic second-hit NF1 pathogenic variants are typically identified in every NF1-associated tumor, including cutaneous and plexiform neurofibromas, and in cafe-au-lait macules, resulting in biallelic NF1 inactivation.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Data cited from a primary study (secondary citation in a consensus paper): refs incl. 37 (CALM melanocytes). Primary paper should be read directly and may support a higher strength.
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
